sheet (trimmed to plate): 6.83 × 6.35 cm (2 11/16 × 2 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of William Wilson Corcoran)
artworks.description: The image portrays a person in profile, showcasing their upper body. The individual is facing to the right with their head turned slightly in profile. Their facial features are clear, highlighting a well-defined nose and lips. The person has curly hair underneath a voluminous headdress. The headdress is ornate, adorned with fabric, lace, and possibly a bow. They are dressed in a high-collared garment, with soft, draping fabric gathered around the neck. An earring is visible in their left ear. The background is a dark circle framing the person, set against a textured, neutral-colored backdrop. Text below the image reads “Mme Bouicel.”

artworks.description: The image shows a profile portrait of a man in a seated position, facing to the left. He has a prominent nose, small lips, and short curly hair tied at the back. He is wearing a dark high-collared jacket and a white cravat. The background is simple, with the man set against a circular dark area. At the bottom, there is some partially visible handwritten text.

artworks.description: This illustration depicts a man's upper body in profile view from the shoulders up. The man has strong facial features, including a prominent nose and chin. He has voluminous styled hair with shorter strands at the front and longer sections at the back. He is wearing a high-collared garment, possibly a formal coat, and a cravat or necktie. He is not holding any objects, and the background is a simple shadow or vignette on a plain surface. The illustration is set against an aged paper backdrop with some text in the lower portion.

artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of William Wilson Corcoran)
artworks.description: The image features a man's profile view showing his upper body. He faces left, displaying distinct facial features including a prominent nose, strong jawline, high forehead, and tightly curled white or very light hair swept back. He wears a high-collared shirt with ruffles under a dark coat, and a scarf or cravat tied neatly around his neck. A hoop earring is visible in his left ear. The background is a textured, dark field with a circular pattern, and below the portrait is the cursive inscription "Eugene Lucus." The image is engraved with fine lines and detailed shading.

The portrait is framed within a circular border on a plain background, with the handwritten name "DeWitt Clinton" below the image.

artworks.description: The image shows a profile portrait of a person depicted from the upper body up. The individual is facing to the right, with a prominent nose and a slightly open mouth. His hair is styled in an 18th-century fashion with textured waves tied at the nape of the neck. The subject wears a dark coat with wide lapels over a white shirt with a cravat at the neck. The background is a dark circle with a name inscribed at the bottom, identifying the person as Pierre Van Courtland.

She has classic facial features, short curly hair, and is wearing a dress with pleated fabric and lace trimming. The background is a muted circular aura. artworks.description: The image shows a young woman's upper body in profile, facing left. She has a prominent nose, full lips, and a rounded chin, with thick, curly hair tied at the back. She wears an elegant ruffled garment with an ornate collar. The background is simple, with handwritten text below identifying her as "Miss Delage," Natalie de Delage de Volade.

artworks.title: John Derby
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: mezzotint and engraving in black on wove paper mounted to brown wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (irregular): 5.56 × 5.56 cm (2 3/16 × 2 3/16 in.)
sheet (trimmed to plate): 6.83 × 6.35 cm (2 11/16 × 2 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of William Wilson Corcoran)
artworks.description: The image shows a profile portrait of a person facing to the right, featuring the upper body with focus on the head and shoulders. The individual has curly shoulder-length hair, detailed facial features including a prominent nose and a rounded chin. They are dressed in a dark coat with a high collar and a light-colored cravat around their neck. In the background, there is a simple circular design with the person's name, John Derby, written below the portrait on a strip of paper. The surrounding background outside the circle is plain and textured.

artworks.title: Place du Havre à Paris
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Martin and Liane Atlas

artworks.title: Frank Burty Haviland
artworks.medium: graphite on paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William Kelly Simpson
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's head and partial upper torso. The head is tilted slightly downward and to the side, with long, wavy lines suggesting hair. The facial features are minimally indicated, with faint outlines for the eyes and mouth, while the nose is more pronounced with angular lines. The person appears to be wearing no visible clothing or accessories. The background is plain and unadorned, with some text and scribbles near the left side of the drawing. The entire composition is rendered in pencil on a light-colored paper.

artworks.title: Virgin Enthroned in Glory with Saint Peter
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of celestial beings among the clouds. The etching features a group of figures adorned with wings, positioned across fluffy clouds. In the center of the image, a prominent figure is seated higher than the others, holding a scepter-like object with rays extending towards it. The surrounding figures, also with wings, appear to be in various poses, some seated and some seemingly in flight. The use of light and shadow adds depth to the composition, bringing the clouds and clothing to life. The scene conveys a sense of movement and grandeur, supported by intricate linework and shading.

artworks.title: Battle of the Lapiths and Centaurs
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in Memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures and warriors in a chaotic melee. The scene includes centaur-like figures with weapons and rearing horses. Figures are depicted mid-action with flowing hair and shadows emphasizing musculature. A table displaying items and a serpent-like creature are present. In the background, hills and a temple are visible. The detailed linework and cross-hatching create depth and emphasize the scene's intensity.

artworks.title: The Madonna of the Veil
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David P. Tunick, in honor of Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a close grouping: two adults and a baby. The adult woman is to the right of a bearded man and holding up a piece of fabric, looking down at the baby below. The woman has delicate facial features, wavy hair, a dress with a round neckline, and a brooch. The man has curly hair, a beard, and is holding a staff. Behind them is a curtain with folds. The baby is reaching upward with outstretched arms, partially covered by the fabric. The background is a dark, textured surface.

artworks.title: 8:30 P.M. Group of newsboys selling at the depot, Hartford, Connecticut. Smallest boy 11 years old.
artworks.medium: gelatin silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Fern M. Schad
artworks.description: The image depicts six young boys standing in front of a building. Most of the boys wear newsboy caps and hold stacks of newspapers. They are dressed in coats, long pants, and boots. The background shows a stone wall with windows and a sign that reads "Spitting on the floor forbidden by order of the Board of Health."

artworks.title: The Education of the Virgin
artworks.medium: red chalk with pen and brown ink and brown wash, heightened with white gouache on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with three figures kneeling and gesturing towards a cloud-like figure surrounded by light. The setting is indoors with a draped curtain. The style is influenced by the Baroque period, with delicate line work and sepia tones depicting the figures and their interactions.

artworks.title: A Man Trapped between a Lion and a Serpent
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper, laid down on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Joseph F. McCrindle Endowment Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a muscular, nude male figure struggling with a large, heavy rock. There is a lion's head on top of the rock and a serpent-like creature slithering nearby. The background shows hilly terrain. The detailed shading and line work create a sense of struggle and tension in the image.

artworks.title: August: Fishing
artworks.medium: brown and gray-brown wash with pen and brown and black ink over traces of black chalk
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures engaged in various activities around a body of water, viewed from almost a side-on perspective. The horizon line is high, with rolling hills and a building visible along it. The painting uses delicate brushstrokes to capture fine details in a monochromatic or grisé technique, primarily using shades of grey and brown. The color palette is muted, consisting of shades of grey and beige. Figures in period attire are shown engaging in tasks close to the viewer, while others interact further away, near trees and a winding path. Trees and foliage frame the scene, with more figures and landscape elements in the background, all under a soft, consistent light.

artworks.title: Rocaille Cartouche
artworks.medium: gray wash with pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: The image shows flowing, curvilinear shapes and intricate swirling lines forming an abstract design. The design is reminiscent of ornate, decorative elements found in classical architecture or baroque art.

artworks.title: Rocaille Cartouche with an Eagle
artworks.medium: gray wash with pen and brown ink and traces of graphite on laid paper, laid down on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts swirling, sinuous lines and ornate shapes in an abstract design. The border is intricately decorated with curling vine-like forms. In the center, there is a large shell-like structure flanked by floral embellishments. Below, there is a form reminiscent of an eagle or mythical bird with outstretched wings. The design is enclosed by a double border with blue and brown lines.

artworks.title: Gust of Wind at Étretat (Coup de vent à Étretat)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Lawrence Lawver
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with looming cliffs on the left, turbulent waves on the right. The horizon is low, with the ocean meeting a sky full of swirling clouds. The cliffs contrast with the crashing waves at their base. Two small figures are on the shore, providing scale. The artwork is monochromatic, with a palette of blacks, grays, and whites. The brushstrokes are expressive, capturing the movement of the waves and clouds with vigor.

artworks.title: Child with a Dog
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The etching shows a young child lying next to a large dog, both of their full bodies visible. The child is reclining against the dog, who seems to be resting. The child's facial features are delicately depicted, with a serene expression and short hair. The child is dressed in a long-sleeved outfit and knee-high socks. The setting appears to be outdoors, with grass texture under them and foliage or trees in the background. There are no additional objects or jewelry visible in the image. The overall tone is monochromatic, created with crosshatch and line work characteristic of an etching style.

artworks.title: The Letter (Reflexion, ou la lettre)
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, seated in a slightly reclined position facing right. Her head is turned toward the viewer, holding a pencil to her chin. She has delicate facial features with a composed expression, neat hair partially covered by an elaborate hat, and wears a high-collared, long-sleeved dress with a voluminous skirt. She sits at a desk with papers. There is no visible jewelry. The background is plain, highlighting the woman as the central subject.

artworks.title: Soldiers in a Windy Landscape
artworks.medium: black chalk and pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a caravan of people and animals traveling along a winding path. The horizon shows distant hills and a line of trees. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing motion and patterns. The color palette includes soft grays, browns, and light tints. Large trees bend in the wind on the sides. Figures on horseback and foot lead the way with dogs. Wagons and more figures extend into the distance, showing continuous movement.
